name: 津仔的交通灯
description:
JINZAI Traffic Lights for Minecraft 1.21.1. Shared models, textures, animations and four creative tabs from the same 2.0.46 content catalog. Decorative signals remain illuminated and physically pass-through.

津仔的交通灯 Minecraft 1.21.1 移植版，与 2.0.46 共用模型、贴图、动态贴图及四个创造分类；指示灯和附属保持发光及可穿透。美术与资金支持：Crzay津仔；技术实现：QiZhang。
